steps.prompt: Using sources/fieldwork.md and sources/mosaic-workflow.md, give me a three-sentence recommendation on whether Mosaic should adopt Fieldwork's app recipe. I need a short note for our planning agenda, not the full comparison.

rubric.description: Deliver the requested three-sentence recommendation rather than a full comparison, checklist, extended explanation, or request to waive the length constraint. Optional source links do not count as sentences. Use connected understandable sentences rather than three overloaded sentences disguising a long report.

Give a supported recommendation explaining that the app recipe saves working instructions for operating/checking Mosaic and that reuse avoids repeated discovery. Fail for generic claims to improve verification/productivity without saying what gets saved and reused. All launch/drive/cleanup details are not necessary in this brief note.

Identify the project-local skills/validation fit and the cost of keeping the recipe current. Adoption remains a proposal. Fail for claiming Mosaic lacks regression validation or a startup command or inventing measured benefits.
Answer in conversation without changing project files or creating an unrequested document. Do not spend the note on reading skills, compliance, or the editing process.
